featured.summary: The shortest path to running open models on your own machine. Pull a model and expose a local API in one command—no cloud account required to wire an LLM into a project.
featured.whyNow: When data cannot leave the building—or you refuse metered APIs—local inference is the only option. Evaluating on-prem starts faster here than in papers.

featured.summary: Ships zero-JS by default and hydrates only where needed (islands). Ideal for docs, blogs, and marketing sites that are mostly content.
featured.whyNow: If most of your site is content with a few interactive pockets, a full SPA tax is unnecessary. This site itself is built with Astro.

featured.summary: Self-hostable visual automation. Wire APIs, databases, and AI models into versionable workflows instead of one-off glue scripts.
featured.whyNow: Top 7-day star gains on the board. AI agents need a glue layer to real systems—workflow engines sit exactly there.
